page.notes: Several entries are read with doubt: "Ofores" (possibly a misprint), "Panitere" (the first letter may be a Poenitere ligature), and "Iefu" in the last line, which I read as Iesu. The last line breaks mid-word and continues beyond this part. The left edge of the entries is shadowed, but the words are legible. The gamma in "N. Γ." is uncertain and may be a Latin letter. The first line is a fragment continuing an entry from the previous part. The reference "p. 434" on Populus is set on a separate raised line in the scan.
